notes: Human (left) hand, entering from the upper left. Provenance: started from round-1 LEFT_HAND_SPEC in src/hand/skeleton.ts, then re-read against aes-ref/alpha-white-geom.PNG on 4-8x zoomed crops (x 280-800, y 120-540); most px changed. Digit names follow user decision D2 (documentation/log/log-v2.md): THUMB = the digit with the large nail facing the viewer, coming diagonally out of the base of the palm, tip ~(559,462) (round 1 had called it the pinky); PINKY = the short leftmost digit curled under the palm, pointing back toward the wrist, tip ~(437,441) (round 1 had called it the thumb); MIDDLE and RING = the two curled digits between, tips ~(600,523) and ~(533,507); INDEX = the extended digit reaching the contact point, tip ~(786,416). MEASURED/READ from the reference: every px (fingertips and knuckle turns read by eye on zoomed crops, joints between them placed on the drawn digit's centre line), and r = projected half-width of the drawn section in reference px. RECONSTRUCTED (not observable in one view): z depths (index and thumb toward the camera, ring and pinky away, consistent with the drawn overlaps), flat (section depth/width, chosen anatomically), dorsal (back of the hand faces up and slightly toward the camera). forearm px lies outside the frame so the arm leaves the frame. Not yet calibrated against the reference mask (log-v2 step 2): baseline scores are in outputs/qa/calib/compare-left/.
